data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3: a README at tests/runners/fixtures/ documents the corpus structure and the metadata schema as the contributor-facing contract

## Description
Author tests/runners/fixtures/README.md as the contributor-facing contract documenting: (1) directory layout (passing/, red-marker/, skipping/ axes; flat fixtures; metadata lives ONLY in corpus-index.yaml); (2) the corpus-index.yaml entry shape as a literal copy (id, verdict, harnesses LIST, description, file, optional drift_ticket); (3) verdict vocabulary {pass, fail, skip}; (4) the manifest plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml as the harness-id authority (validator degrades to presence-only when absent); (5) validate-corpus.py is the source of truth for the verdict enum; (6) the corpus is a PROTECTED hand-curated artifact excluded from auto-remediation epics.

## TDD Requirement
Exempt per Unit exemption criterion 3: documentation-only static asset, no executable assertion possible.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] README exists at the fixtures root
  Verify: test -f tests/runners/fixtures/README.md
- [ ] README documents all three axis directory names
  Verify: grep -q 'passing' tests/runners/fixtures/README.md && grep -q 'red-marker' tests/runners/fixtures/README.md && grep -q 'skipping' tests/runners/fixtures/README.md
- [ ] README documents the four required metadata fields
  Verify: grep -q 'id' tests/runners/fixtures/README.md && grep -Eq '\bverdict\b' tests/runners/fixtures/README.md && grep -Eq '\bharnesses\b' tests/runners/fixtures/README.md && grep -Eq '\bdescription\b' tests/runners/fixtures/README.md
- [ ] README documents the verdict vocabulary tokens
  Verify: grep -q 'pass' tests/runners/fixtures/README.md && grep -q 'fail' tests/runners/fixtures/README.md && grep -q 'skip' tests/runners/fixtures/README.md
- [ ] README names the manifest as harness-id authority and validate-corpus.py as enum source of truth
  Verify: grep -q 'test-runners.yaml' tests/runners/fixtures/README.md && grep -q 'validate-corpus.py' tests/runners/fixtures/README.md
- [ ] README notes the corpus is a protected hand-curated artifact
  Verify: grep -Eqi 'protected|hand-curated|auto-remediation' tests/runners/fixtures/README.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Document the fixture corpus structure and metadata schema in tests/runners/fixtures/README.md
